mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism and increase chloroquine bioavailability; both agents can cause GI irritation and turmeric may potentiate chloroquine's effects on hemoglobin.
action: Monitor for chloroquine toxicity signs (visual disturbances, myopathy, arrhythmias); consider spacing doses and baseline/periodic ophthalmic screening if combined use necessary.
